otl.name: Open Tree of Life synthetic tree, release opentree16.1 (labelled_supertree_simplified_ottnames.tre)
otl.licence: CC0 public domain dedication, 'where not limited by pre-existing terms of use' (https://tree.opentreeoflife.org/about/licenses, read 2026-10-08)
otl.licence_caveat: The CC0 statement carries the qualifier 'where not limited by pre-existing terms of use'; the synthesis is built from many published studies, whose individual terms were not audited here.

otl.tip_labels: species names with Open Tree taxonomy id suffix, e.g. Canis_lupus_ott247341 (binomials; a few tips are higher taxa or subspecies). Join to GBIF needs stripping '_ott<id>' and underscores, or the OTT taxonomy id cross-references (not checked here).
otl.internal_labels: every internal node is named: taxon names (Canidae_ott770319) or unnamed-node ids (mrcaott42ott240665); no support values
